statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
There is concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology
The patient has a history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
CPT code 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring) was ordered
The service is to capture intermittent cardiac events and assess for potential atrial or ventricular arrhythmias
